settings.sql_transform:
SELECT
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'alert_name') as alert_name, 
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'alertname') as alertname, 
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'app') as app, 
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'channel') as channel, 
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'cluster') as cluster, 
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'cluster_name') as cluster_name,
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'code') as code,
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'container') as container,
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'datasource_uid') as datasource_uid,
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'grafana_folder') as grafana_folder,
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'instance') as instance,
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'job') as job,
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'persistentvolume') as persistentvolume,
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'persistentvolumeclaim') as persistentvolumeclaim,
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'pod') as pod,
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'reason') as reason,
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'ref_id') as ref_id, 
simpleJSONExtractString(commonLabels, 'rulename') as rulename,
*
FROM {STREAM}

functions.name: enrich_new
functions.sql: (product, column) -> if (product = 'TrafficPeak Shared', dictGet(usage_shared_new, column, tuple(cluster_hostname, project_name)), dictGet(usage_dedicated_new, column, cluster_hostname))

functions.name: enrich
functions.sql: (product, column) -> if (product = 'TrafficPeak Shared', dictGet(usage_shared, column, tuple(cluster_hostname, project_name)), dictGet(usage_dedicated, column, cluster_hostname))

tables.description: Table for receiving usage data from wild clusters.
tables.name: meter

transforms.description: Transform to accept usage data from wild clusters.
transforms.name: usagemeter

settings.sql_transform:
SELECT 
dictGet(usage_dedicated_new, 'Hydrolix_Product__c', cluster_hostname) as product,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Account_Name__c') as account_name,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Id') as deployment_id,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Channel__c') as channel_name,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Channel_Tracking_ID__c') as channel_tracking_id,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Cost_Type__c') as cost_type,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Sales_Region__c') as sales_region,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Sales_Country__c') as sales_country,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Commit_Type__c') as ctypes,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Commit_Bytes__c') as cbytes,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Commit_Rows__c') as crows,
multiIf(ctypes = 'TB per Month', cbytes * 1099511627776, ctypes = 'Billion records per month', crows * 1000000000, null)  as commit_value,
multiIf(ctypes = 'TB per Month', 'Bytes', ctypes = 'Billion records per month', 'Rows', null) as commit_unit,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'MRR_Gross__c') as mrr_gross,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'MRR_Net__c')  as mrr_net,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'MRR_Data_Gross__c')  as mrr_data_gross,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'MRR_Data_Net__c')  as mrr_data_net,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Opportunity_ID__c')  as opty_id,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Contract_ID__c')  as contract_id,
usage_enrich_new(product, 'Commit_QPM__c')  as commit_qpm,
if(product = 'TrafficPeak Shared', concat(cluster_hostname, ' - ', project_name), null) as cluster_project_name,
*
FROM {STREAM}
